questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Israel?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Israel article.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “There is a long history of conflict between Israel and _____.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Israel”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Israel article.

questions.proof: There is a long history of conflict between Israel and Palestine.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Isaac Herzog has been the President of Israel since July _____.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “The President” part of the Israel article.

questions.proof: Isaac Herzog has been the President of Israel since July 2021.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “But Israel's economy has grown tremendously since _____.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Economy” part of the Israel article.

questions.proof: But Israel's economy has grown tremendously since 1948.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “_____ annexed what became known as the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and Egypt occupied the Gaza Strip.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “annexed”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Israel article, under the heading “During the modern Common Era”.

questions.proof: Jordan annexed what became known as the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and Egypt occupied the Gaza Strip.
